articles.title: WSL talking points: Tullis-Joyce takes charge and is Shaw the perfect striker?
articles.summary: The City forward hit a WSL hat-trick for the ninth time while Eva Olid's United have found defensive stability Not only did Khadija “Bunny” Shaw score a record-extending ninth WSL hat-trick, she scored a “perfect hat-trick” for the fourth time in the competition, something nobody else has managed more than once. Against West Ham the Jamaica striker opened the scoring with her left foot, headed home her second off the underside of the crossbar and tucked in her third with her right foot late on.
